subject: texi2dvi does not execute in rapache

messages.author: c708f0e53b26cb42
messages.subject: texi2dvi does not execute in rapache
parts:
Hi all,
I'm trying to serve pdfs by using brew+latex on rapache. Inspired by
this post http://biostatmatt.com/archives/1184 which does it by using
sweave instead of brew.

So the idea is that I have a report.brew file which is brew (latex+R
code) file.

The handler picks these brew files and:

1. compiles the brew and creates the tex file
brew(report.brew, report.tex)

2. compiles the tex file and creates a pdf
texti2dvi(report.tex, pdf=TRUE)

3. redirects the user to the pdf file.

The problem is that while the handler does indeed compile from brew to
tex, the second step: texti2dvi fails.
The error message that shown the browser is:

Error en tools::texi2dvi(texfile, clean = TRUE, pdf = TRUE) :
Running 'texi2dvi' on '/Library/WebServer/Documents/rreports/
report1.tex' failed.
Traceback:
3: stop(msg, domain = NA)
2: tools::texi2dvi(texfile, clean = TRUE, pdf = TRUE) at
ReportHandler.R#29
1: ReportHandler(file = "/Library/WebServer/Documents/rreports/
report1.brew",
envir = .rAenv)

the crazy thing is that if i run the handler code in a R console, it
works. texti2dvi does produce the pdf from the brewed tex file.

Here is the hanlder code:

ReportHandler <- function(file, envir) {
library(brew)
library(tools)

oldwd <- getwd()
setwd(dirname(file))

# Set up filenames
#rndname <- paste(sample(letters, 16, replace=TRUE), collapse='')
bsefile <- paste(sub("\\.[^\\.]*$", "", file))
texfile <- paste(bsefile, ".tex", sep="")
pdffile <- paste(bsefile, ".pdf", sep="")
lnkurl <- basename(pdffile)

# brew!
attach(envir, warn.conflicts=FALSE)
brew(file, texfile)
tools::texi2dvi(texfile, clean=TRUE, pdf=TRUE)
detach(envir)

# Redirect to the newly created PDF
setContentType("text/html; charset=UTF-8;")
cat("<DOCTYPE! html><html><head>")
cat(paste("<meta http-equiv=\"Refresh\" content=\"0;URL=",
lnkurl, "\">", sep=""))
cat("</head><body></body></html>")

setwd(oldwd)
}

Any idea will be appreciated! :-)

Xavi.

You might be running into a file permissions problem, meaning that the
user running the web server cannot create the temporary files
typically produced by a run of latex. Do these two things:

1. Call setwd() to some temporary directory (scope out tempdir() i
think) and then call texi2dvi()
2. Be sure the web server user can create the pdf files where you want them.

Jeff

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: texi2dvi does not execute in rapache
parts:
Hmmm....

I recently had an issue running pdflatex from rApache: temporary fonts
would not be created. I determined this by looking at the .log file
produced by the latex run which pointed to a failed font creation
command. I ended up running the font creation command from a shell
running as the same user as the web server. This fixed the issue in
rApache, but I bet if I created another report that needed a different
font I'd have to do the same shell trick. There may be some
environment variables (possibly $HOME) missing via the web server ->
rApache -> pdflatex execution.

So, try and find the .log file created when rApache runs texi2dvi and
see where that gets you.
